svg.title: What agentlane up does
svg.desc: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor start on one project. The command agentlane up gives each its own lane: its own ports, dev server and database, plus browser, iOS simulator or Android emulator. Each agent drives its own copy of the app, typing an item into the list and ticking items off, and takes screenshots. When Codex is done, its lane is released and folds away, and the loop starts again.
